region_order: Prologue: tutorial, Lilac and Gooseberries (ghouls, loot skull, Gwent with Aldert, buy cards from Elsa)
Captain -> The Beast of White Orchard; Tomira -> On Death's Bed; do Missing in Action, Precious Cargo, Frying Pan, Twisted Firestarter, Viper diagrams, treasure hunts BEFORE the Vesemir talk
Report griffin (safe) -> manual save -> Vesemir at inn (point of no return) -> Incident -> Imperial Audience
The Nilfgaardian Connection (gate for all Velen)
Hunting a Witch -> Wandering in the Dark (accept and finish Magic Lamp inside the ruins) -> An Invitation from Keira Metz
Bloody Baron -> King of the Wolves -> Family Matters up to botchling/Tamara; play the Baron at Gwent now
Lynch Mob (Hangman's Alley) -> A Towerful of Mice -> A Favor for a Friend -> For the Advancement of Learning (send Keira to Kaer Morhen); Forefathers' Eve after Towerful
Ladies of the Wood (Whispering Hillock after the ealdorman) -> Fleeing the Bog
Skellige: The Calm Before the Storm before telling the Baron about Anna
Finish Family Matters -> Return to Crookback Bog -> Out of the Shadows
Hazardous Goods, then Reardon Manor and Ghosts of the Past (if Letho alive)
Remaining Velen side quests/contracts/Gwent at their level; everything on the Isle cutoff list before the boat; Devil by the Well before On Thin Ice
